name: Bugs board help
description: Help mode entries for the bugs board (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Bugs
entries.text: The confirmed bugs board: every open bug grouped by the build it is part of, with that build's live state (running with its agent and step, queued with its place in line, built with its PR, merged). Drag a bug by its grip to reorder it or drop it on another build.

entries.title: Open bugs
entries.text: How many confirmed bugs are open, how many have no build yet and how many wait on you. Tap it to open the bugs board.

entries.title: Open bugs
entries.text: Opens the bugs board.

entries.title: Bugs settings
entries.text: Settings for the bugs board: auto-optimize, the most bugs one build may take, which builds the optimizer looks at and how handoffs show in the crew chat.

entries.title: Add bug
entries.text: Opens the form for a new confirmed bug. It lands at the top of Unassigned (or straight in a build when auto-optimize is on).

entries.title: Auto-optimize
entries.text: When on, new and unassigned bugs are moved into the best queued or running build by themselves (zero tokens: matched by words, app, area and the files the build touches). Off by default.

entries.title: Optimize…
entries.text: Shows the moves auto-optimize would make right now, with the reason for each. Nothing changes until you tap Apply; Undo takes the whole batch back.

entries.title: Undo
entries.text: Takes back the last batch of moves (an optimize run or a new build from bugs).

entries.title: New build from selected
entries.text: Starts a new build in the active profile with one 'Fix bug' step per selected bug, and moves the bugs into it.

entries.title: New build from bug
entries.text: Starts a new build in the active profile with a 'Fix bug' step for this bug, and moves the bug into it.

entries.title: Mark fixed
entries.text: Marks the bug fixed. Bugs are also marked fixed by themselves when their build's PR merges.

entries.title: Won't fix
entries.text: Closes the bug without fixing it. It moves to the Won't fix group; Reopen brings it back.

entries.title: Reopen
entries.text: Puts a fixed or closed bug back on the board as confirmed.

entries.title: Remove
entries.text: Takes the bug off the board for good (after a confirm).

entries.title: Open build
entries.text: Opens the Build orchestrator, where this build's steps and brief are.

entries.title: Move to build
entries.text: Pick a queued or running build for this bug. The bug gets a 'Fix bug' step and an addendum there, the running session is told, and the build's agent answers in the crew chat.

entries.title: Move
entries.text: Moves the bug into the picked build.

entries.title: Severity
entries.text: How bad the bug is: urgent, high, normal or low. Auto-optimize homes the worst ones first.

entries.title: App
entries.text: Which app the bug is in (console-web, molly, axhub-web…). The board can filter by it and the optimizer matches on it.

entries.title: Area
entries.text: The plugin, screen or part of the app (e.g. console-terminal, banner tokens). The optimizer matches it against each build's brief and steps.

entries.title: Tags
entries.text: Extra words for matching and filtering, comma separated.

entries.title: What Brett said
entries.text: Your exact words about the bug. They travel with it into the build's addendum.

entries.title: Title
entries.text: A short line that says what is broken.

entries.title: Details
entries.text: What happens, where, and how to make it happen.

entries.title: By build
entries.text: Shows the bugs grouped by build, with each build's live state on its header.

entries.title: List
entries.text: Shows every bug in one list in board order, each with its build chip.

entries.title: Open
entries.text: Only open bugs (confirmed or in a build).

entries.title: All
entries.text: Every bug, fixed and closed ones too.

entries.title: Fixed
entries.text: Only fixed bugs, with the PR that fixed them.

entries.title: View
entries.text: By build or one list.

entries.title: Status
entries.text: Which bugs to show: open, all, fixed or won't fix.

entries.title: Profile
entries.text: Only bugs of one build profile.

entries.title: Builds the optimizer looks at
entries.text: The active build profile's builds only, or every profile's.

entries.title: Most bugs per build
entries.text: Auto-optimize and the agents never put more open bugs than this on one build; a full build bounces new ones.

entries.title: Match threshold
entries.text: How strong a match must be before auto-optimize moves a bug. Higher = fewer, surer moves.

entries.title: Skip old builds
entries.text: Auto-optimize leaves builds nobody touched for this many days alone. Dragging onto them still works.

entries.title: Ask AI button
entries.text: Lets you ask a model about bugs auto-optimize can't place. Off by default because it costs tokens.

entries.title: Handoffs in the crew chat
entries.text: Posts every move in the crew group chat: the sender tags the build's agent, who takes it or bounces it.

entries.title: Chat tone
entries.text: Street (crew slang) or clean lines for the handoffs.

entries.title: When bounced
entries.text: Auto-reroute: Boss offers a bounced bug to the next best build until someone takes it. Ask Brett: it waits for you with the best builds to pick from.

entries.title: Bounces before asking Brett
entries.text: After this many bounces in a row the bug goes back to Unassigned and waits for you.

entries.title: Cancel
entries.text: Closes this without changing anything.

entries.title: Apply
entries.text: Makes the proposed moves. Each one is offered to the build's agent in the crew chat first.

entries.title: Close
entries.text: Closes the bug's editor.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves your changes to the bug.
